basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old living in Whittier, California. By day, I work as a freelance graphic designer, often using LibreOffice for quick document edits. My evenings are typically spent listening to Elvis Duran while I catch up on the latest memes from MemePiece. I'm single and enjoy exploring the local music scene, particularly metal bands. I'm fairly new to the world of Reddit but enjoy the diversity of conversations it offers. My online hours are usually late evening to early morning, as that's when my creative juices flow the best.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, having studied Visual Arts at a local community college. Over the years, I've honed my skills through online courses and self-directed projects. My interest in technology stems from my work, leading me to follow developments in software like LibreOffice.
